lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the pectoral fin, forming a semi-regular grid with three to four nodes per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are clearly visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to form a rectangular grid-like structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper and middle flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of high-luminance spots is visible within the first dorsal fin silhouette, exhibiting lower geometric organization than the lateral flank grid.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small notch or irregularity visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, non-grid-aligned clustering of small spots concentrated on the leading edge and distal surface of the right pectoral fin.
